title: Strings and characters
description:
Complete the methods:

```java
static String caesar(String text, int shift)     // shift letters through the alphabet, keeping case; other characters unchanged
static boolean isAnagram(String a, String b)     // same letters in any order, ignoring case, spaces and punctuation
static String compress(String s)                 // "aaabccdddd" gives "a3bc2d4"
static String capitalizeWords(String s)          // "the QUICK brown" gives "The Quick Brown"; single spaces in the result
```

- `caesar("Hello, World!", 3)` is `"Khoor, Zruog!"`; shifts can be negative or larger than 26.
- `compress` writes a count only when a character repeats; when the compressed text would not be shorter, it returns the original.
hints: `c - 'a'` is a letter's position (0 to 25); add the shift, take `% 26`, and add `'a'` back. `Math.floorMod(shift, 26)` turns negative and large shifts into 0 to 25.
For anagrams, count each letter up for the first string and down for the second: they are anagrams when every count ends at 0.
